evidence.quote: The RTE Act provides for the right of children to free and compulsory education till completion of elementary education in a neighbourhood school . It clarifies that ' compulsory education ' means obligation of the appropriate government to provide free elementary education and ensure compulsory admission , attendance and completion of elementary education to every child in the six to fourteen age group . ' Free ' means that no child shall be liable to pay any kind of fee or charges or expenses which may prevent him or her from pursuing and completing elementary education .

Children are admitted in to private schools based on caste - based reservations . See Page 9 and Point no 4 of This Document .
